reviews.author: Karina C…
reviews.body: Every session has been a new improvement. From focusing on my foot to a full body treatment and every new day that I'm back at the gym or go to work I feel so much more alleviated. My fitness and work performance is more durable and in less pain.

reviews.author: Karina C…
reviews.body:
I have withheld so much with my feet. I'm a 27 year old woman, who at a young age never wore the correct kind of shoes and has been physically active since I was 15, including doing Zumba for 10years, always on foot at my jobs, and bodybuilding at the gym. My feet have been messed up for years and with past injuries that never got treated until now that I have been seeing Solomon. Does the therapy hurt? Absolutely, but in my mindset I rather deal with the pain of getting treated than to regret it later when I get older and more crippled from not fixing the problem now while I'm young. 

Solomon has amazing natural remedies and the best hands to do the right kind of work. I have seen amazing progess in my feet just from the first week of treatment. Like I said I'm always heavy lifting-pushing, moving, pulling, whether it's the gym or at work. Even with the orthopedic shoes being slightly helpful, getting the proper treatment helps on the long run. I 1000% recommend others getting treated by Solomon
